content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real), Analysis.derivable(F, x), Analysis.maxPoint(F, x)), Analysis.deriv(F, x, $0$))
content.markdown:
At an interior local extremum where the derivative exists, the derivative vanishes. Both hypotheses are load-bearing: `x ↦ x` on `[0, 1]` has extrema only at the endpoints, and `x ↦ |x|` has an interior minimum where the derivative fails to exist.

The converse is false — `x ↦ x³` has vanishing derivative at `0` and no extremum there — so this is a necessary condition only.
